Don't forget to complete the following steps:

Environment variables:
  .env.development:
    - DB_HOST
    - DB_PORT
    - DB_DATABASE
    - DB_USERNAME
    - DB_PASSWORD
    - GOOGLE_CLOUD_STORAGE_BUCKET
    - GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID

Configuration:
  GCS:
    - Provide the service account key (set disks.gcs.key_file_path in config/filesystems.php)
  Telescope:
    - Add \Laravel\Telescope\Http\Middleware\Authorize::class to the middleware list (in config/telescope.php)
